about: The re-grip into one hand (KE task 10, D15): the one-handed guard's first 9 frames (0.3 s, the owner's length), starting in the two-handed guard's first pose and carried into the one-handed guard, the off hand leaving the handle, the feet where the guard has them. Played on the upper body over the legs on a switch to one hand while standing, moving or guarding; picture only. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
